items.name: 瘦长脸打工人
items.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL Chinese chat sticker CHARACTER AUDITION SHEET, landscape 3 equal columns on warm white background, three separate complete waist-up drawings of the SAME original adult Chinese male office worker. Each column has generous space with one short exact Chinese caption beneath: LEFT "忙着呢", CENTER "心累", RIGHT "下班了". Hand-drawn sparse charcoal black lines, tiny flat muted slate-blue shirt accent, expressive grayscale facial planes. ORIGINAL angular elongated face, short slightly messy sidepart hair, narrow shoulders, long nose, loose collar with rolled sleeves, small asymmetrical brows. Not panda, not mushroom/bowl haircut, not celebrity or existing meme face, not photographic face pasted on body. Draw facial anatomy expressively without grotesque ugliness. Three meaning-specific performances: left leaning toward a small laptop, focused narrowed eyes at screen and typing hands, compressed mouth, not angry; center slack shoulders, heavy eyelids staring into distance, slack crooked mouth, hand holding cheek, exhausted rather than angry; right delighted eyes crescent shaped, open relieved grin, raised stretching arms with elbows bent, confident joyful end-of-work feeling. Strong believable eye direction and brows/mouth/gesture coordination. Funny ONLY where natural, not random exaggerated faces. Every pose same recognizable identity, radically different emotion. Editorial sketch sticker aesthetic, not polished generic vector mascot, no excessive details or background props. Each figure fully contained, blank margins, accurate legible Chinese captions, no other text, logos or watermarks.

items.name: 圆脸短发小伙
items.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL Chinese chat sticker CHARACTER AUDITION SHEET, landscape three equal columns on warm white, three complete waist-up drawings of SAME appealing adult Chinese young man. Exact short Chinese captions under respective columns: LEFT "收到", CENTER "谢谢", RIGHT "加油". Original rounded rectangular face, neat short textured crew haircut (NOT bowlcut), strong lively eyebrows, clear bright expressive eyes, broad friendly grin with one cheek dimple, sturdy proportions and muted terracotta hoodie. Attractive approachable adult, not baby/cute chibi, not celebrity, not panda/mushroom meme, NO pasted photographic face. Style hand-drawn minimal ink contours with light pencil shading and sparse warm color, sophisticated expressive reaction sticker, clearly different from skinny exhausted worker archetype. Left: attentive direct eye contact, tiny nod and modest thumbs-up near chest, mouth confident slight smile, reliable acknowledgment. Center: genuine warm grateful eyes, gentle lowered brows and head inclination, both hands loosely clasped at chest, sincere smile not comic mockery or begging. Right: determined energetic eyebrows, smiling eyes looking at viewer, one small clenched fist by shoulder encouraging someone, mouth open cheering, not aggressive. Expressions and gestures MUST differ meaningfully, subtle eye direction and facial muscles support exact captions. Minimal white surroundings, no scenery or extra props, clear silhouettes, sufficient whitespace, legible accurate captions, no other text/watermarks. Prioritize warmth, sincerity and emotional readability rather than forcing funny faces on every phrase.

items.name: 耷拉眼小狗
items.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL hand-drawn dog chat sticker CHARACTER AUDITION SHEET, landscape three equal columns, warm white background. Three complete chest-up poses of the SAME distinctive original scruffy little dog, caption beneath each: LEFT "搞不懂", CENTER "委屈", RIGHT "期待". Design: asymmetrical floppy ears (one fold higher), long soft drooping eyelids, slightly pear-shaped muzzle with small oval black nose, tuft of three irregular hairs, cream fur with one muted cocoa ear, simple black ink contours and tiny pale tan pencil shading. This is a DOG, not human face collage, not panda, mushroomhead or known cartoon character. Avoid slick generic vector/corporate mascot and avoid copying popular dog stickers. Sparse drawn lines but sophisticated anatomically readable eyes, eyebrows and mouth. LEFT bewilderment: head tilts slightly, one brow raised other knitted, eyes looking sideways at own raised paw, tiny skewed mouth, funny mild confusion. CENTER hurt/委屈: ears lower, inner brows rise, wet lower eyelids but no torrents, lip trembles closed, paws held together low, looking up shyly, evokes sympathy rather than joke. RIGHT anticipation: ears perk partially, eyes widen focused above in front, muzzle lifts, little eager smile and paws propped just below chin, hopeful not manic. Same individual in all columns, distinct expressions/gestures and emotional beats, not just swapping caption. Character fully contained in each panel with large clean margins, accurate Chinese text, no extra text/logos/watermarks, clean sticker-ready presentation.

edits.prompt: Edit this original dog character audition sheet. Preserve all THREE dog identities, facial expressions, paw gestures and exact Chinese captions 搞不懂 / 委屈 / 期待. Fix ONLY the background and edge noise: replace ALL colorful red/yellow/gray/black speckled background artifacts with completely SOLID OPAQUE WHITE, including around and behind the captions and between fur edges. No transparency anywhere, no texture outside dogs, no colored haloes, no border frames. Black text remains crisp and visible on white. Preserve the cream/cocoa fur, eyes and all poses. Clean professional white paper presentation. Entire canvas opaque RGB appearance.
